name: Quarry
description:
An achievement hunter for wherever you're standing: which achievements you can finish on the current map, what's left on each, and the nearest objective to walk to — with waypoint suggestions, a Target List that stays small on purpose, and Hunt mode, which turns on a marker pack's routes for what you're hunting (needs the Pathing module).
Based on Denrage's Achievement Tracker (MIT): https://github.com/Denrage/AchievementTrackerModule
